title: The Impossible Harbor
author: Noor Underhill
blurb: Paloma Sandoval, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
